errorStats.definition: D-026. Over the n scored steps k of `steps` (n is given with each forecaster's statistics), e_k = forecast_k - observed_k, i.e. predicted minus actual (Q_gB,i), where forecast_k is that step's persistence or frozen forecast and observed_k its archived observed window mean (the same values the MAE uses; window means unchanged, D-013). MSE = (1/n) * sum_k e_k^2 (Q_gB,i^2). RMSE = sqrt(MSE) (Q_gB,i). squaredErrorRange = [min_k e_k^2, max_k e_k^2] (Q_gB,i^2): the 'range of MSE', read as the spread of the per-step squared errors the MSE averages (interpretation recorded in D-026 sec. 2). errorRange = [min_k e_k, max_k e_k] (Q_gB,i): the range of the signed predicted - actual differences. With n = 0 every value is null.

fixtures.label: stella MAE, persistence forecast
fixtures.note: Computed with the stated method and the time-weighted edge-interpolated window mean (D-013), forecasts held at the right edge (no look-ahead); not tuned to the PRD (D-008); the MAE fixtures do not match. A time-weighted sample-and-hold (zero-order hold, edge-clipped) window mean reproduces BOTH PRD scores (persistence 0.044418 → 0.0444, frozen 0.042332 → 0.0423) but gives stella 300–400 = 2.5569 (prints 2.56, PRD 2.55) for the transport fixtures, so no single tested definition reproduces all six PRD numbers. D-013 is kept for every window mean. Other definitions (persistence / frozen MAE): sample mean, half-open windows a<=t<b: 0.044667 / 0.041857; sample-span trapezoid (samples a<=t<=b, divided by t_last-t_first): 0.044037 / 0.041556; edge-interpolated for forecasts too (one-sample look-ahead): 0.043998 / 0.041794. Removing the look-ahead changes the MAE from 0.043998 / 0.041794 to 0.043968 / 0.041794.

method: Windows: initialisation [1450,1500]; steps k=0..7 on [1500+50k, 1550+50k], i.e. [1500,1550] ... [1850,1900]. Observed local mean = time-weighted mean (1/(b-a)) * integral_a^b Q dt of the archived stella bean trace, with Q linearly interpolated at the window edges (trapezoid rule; restart-overlap duplicates removed; D-013). Forecaster's mean of a completed window = the same integral but with the value at the right edge b held at the last sample <= b, so no sample after the window is used. Persistence forecast for step k = forecaster's mean of the previous completed window (the initialisation window for k=0), updated after each reveal. Frozen forecast = forecaster's initialisation-window mean for every step, never updated. Because of the held edge, the persistence forecast for step k can differ from the revealed observation of window k-1 (interpolated edge), by up to about 1e-4 on the archived stella trace; it is not literally 'the previous observed value'. Error = |observed - forecast|; MAE = mean over the 8 steps.
